example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো একটা ঢোঁড়া, কোনো ক্ষমতা নেই তার।
example_sentences_in_english: He is just a dhora, with no power at all.
What can this powerless figure do in politics?
note: Refers to a blind or helpless figure, often implying ineffectiveness in a derogatory manner rooted in rural Bengali expressions.
